Name: Flowery Ridgeside Weapons
Author: Ech0l0cation
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Recolours the weapons given to you for reaching 10 hearts with villagers to add flowers and vines.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Download and extract! its made to not need any file alteration[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]you have the options to choose between the flowers for each level of tool progrestion, or made them update based off of combat level![/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Requires Ridgeside because this is a visual mode for Rideside[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thank you to skellady for giving me permission to make and upload this mod![/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Mods used in this is  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6166]Overgrown Flowery Interface[/url] by  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/83494008]36maraluna[/url] [/color]
